edges.rationale: at r = 0 both sides are 0; for r > 0 the left side is (gX(u,r) − gBarX(u,r))/r
gX(u,r) is g(r) of the slice h_v at v = min(u,u₀) ≤ u₀

for r > 0, (g(r) − ḡ(r))/r = r⁻²∫₀^r 4π g(s)A(s)² ds with A = h_v − h̄_v

g(s) ≤ 1 and A² ≥ 0, so 4π g A² ≤ 4π A²
integrating 4π g A² ≤ π x² s²/(1+s)⁴ over [0,r]
both integrands are continuous, hence integrable on [0,r]
